translations.name: Jefferson Park Ministries
translations.description: Jefferson Park Ministries gives diapers to low-income families with young children, with no income verification. Bring the child's birth certificate and a photo ID. It is first come, first served. Diapers: 3rd Thursday, 1-5pm. The pantry, which also has diapers: 2nd and 3rd Thursday, 1-5pm.
translations.website_description: Learn how to get diapers and baby supplies.
